import "date"
import "timezone"

// Set the global location context
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur")

badState = (r) =>
    not exists r.state or // CPMS down
    r.state == 4 or // FAULT
    r.state == 5 or // UNAVAILABLE
    r.state == -1   // UNKNOWN

start = today()
stop = now()

from(bucket: "cpms")
    |> range(start: date.sub(d: 10m, from: start), stop: stop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plantStatus")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId == "plant1")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "state" or r._field == "emergency" or r._field == "lockout")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
    |> fill(usePrevious: true)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= v.timeRangeStart)
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: start,
        _value: if badState(r: r) or r.emergency == 1 or r.lockout == 1 then 0.0 else 1.0
    }))
    |> mean()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: now(),
        _value: r._value * 100.0,
        _field: "plantAvailability"
    }))

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "plantStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "remoteMode" or r["_field"] == "plantMode" or r["_field"] == "health" or r["_field"] == "state")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "cpms")
    |> range(start: -5m)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plantStatus")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId == "plant1")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "remoteMode" or r._field == "requestOnSource")
    |> last()
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["deviceId"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: now(),
        controlAuthority:
            if r.remoteMode == 0 then 0 // MANUAL
            else if r.requestOnSource == 1 then 1 //"Take Control"
            else 2 //"Auto",
    }))

        |> group()
        |> aggregateWindow(every: period, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            _time: r._time,
            coolingLoadRT: r._value
        }))

        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

stop = now()

getFieldValue = (tables=<-, field) => {
    extract = tables
        |> findColumn(fn: (key) => key._field == field, column: "_value")

    return extract[0]
}

durationInHours = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plantStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId == "plant1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "state")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last)
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> getFieldValue(field: "state")
  

coolingLoad = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "chiller")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "estimatedLoadRt")
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "loadUsage")
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with avgRT: r.loadUsage / durationInHours,
      coolingCapacity: r.loadUsage / durationInHours * ${RT_TO_KW},
      key: "1",
      order: 0,
  }))
  |> group()

defCoolingLoad = union(tables: [coolingLoad, array.from(rows: [{ avgRT: 0.0, loadUsage: 0.0, coolingCapacity: 0.0, key: "1", order: 1}])])
  |> sort(columns: ["order"])

    key: "1"
  }))
  |> group()

join.inner(left: defCoolingLoad, right: power, on: (l, r) => l.key == r.key,

    l with avgPower: r.avgKw,
    energyUsage: r.energyUsage,
    efficiency: if l.avgRT > 0.0 then r.avgKw / l.avgRT else 0.0,
    cop: if r.avgKw > 0.0 then l.coolingCapacity / r.avgKw else 0.0,
    durationInHours: durationInHours
  })
)

with chillers (id, text) AS (
    VALUES
        ('chiller1', 'Chiller 1'),
        ('chiller2', 'Chiller 2'),
        ('chiller3', 'Chiller 3')
),
chwps as (
select cp.equipment_id as id, coalesce(replace(value::text, '"', ''), '') as chwp from control_params cp where key = 'chiller.chwpId'
),
cwps as (
select cp.equipment_id as id, coalesce(replace(value::text, '"', ''), '') as cwp from control_params cp where key = 'chiller.cwpId'
),
defcap as (
	select value from control_params cp where key = 'chiller.capacity' and cp.equipment_id is null 
),
cap as (
	select cp.equipment_id , value from control_params cp where key = 'chiller.capacity' and cp.equipment_id is not null 
)
select c.*, p.chwp, p2.cwp, coalesce(cap.value, defcap.value) as capacity from chillers c left join chwps  p on c.id = p.id left join cwps  p2 on c.id = p2.id left join cap on (cap.equipment_id = c.id) left join defcap on true
order by c.id
